arStrings.szText: (shivers) Thank the Heavens I found this cabin, or I might have frozen stiff. Only now that I’ve thawed, I am reminded why I left Tristram. Sitting alone in my study, ears ringing in the silence you left behind.
I still hear your voice, Amelia. Begging me to put down my books and be a husband, a father, but now... What am I meant to be now?
I have come to doubt Jered's writings hold the answer, but I have no better guide. He speaks of a grand city of the grasses, old as Old Kehjan. With any luck, there will be a tavern.
